## What it is

One solid to print before a level. Two short lap tongues, a pin, and a socket, joined by 2 mm tabs you snap off.

## Design notes

- The clearances match the real parts: 0.3 mm on the lap, 0.2 mm across the flats of the diamond, 0.2 mm on the clocking groove. None of these have been fitted.
- Nothing here has been fitted on a bench. If the pin is tight or the lap rocks, change those three numbers and reprint the coupon, not the whole stack.
- The tongues lie flat, the same way the crosses print. The pin and the socket stand up.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't treat a coupon that fits as proof the whole stack is stiff. It only checks the pin and the lap.
